#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    int x = m;
    int size = 0;
    while (x != 0) {
        x /= w;
        size++;
    }

    std::vector<int> digit(size);
    x = m;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        digit[i] = x % w;
        x /= w;
    }

    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < size && ok; i++) {
        int d = digit[i];
        if (d == 0 || d == 1) {
            continue;
        }
        if (d == w - 1) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < size) {
                if (digit[j] == w - 1) {
                    digit[j] = 0;
                } else {
                    digit[j]++;
                    break;
                }
                j++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        ok = false;
    }

    std::cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
